thread:
sre-maya: noticed a cluster-wide spike in apiserver accept queue and controller-manager leader flaps in eu-central this morning. GPU attach rate processing slowed.
infra-raj: alert fired for apiserver 5xxs and high acceptq at 10:05 UTC. grabbing metrics and tcp dumps.
oncall-bot: Infra Alert: apiserver_acceptq > 500 for controlplane-eu-central (3/3 hosts)
ops-lena: tcpdump shows many SYN retransmits from provisioner clients, connection churn looks high. conntrack table usage at 98% on cp nodes.
platform-sam: provisioning path uses short-lived HTTP requests for each attach; no connection reuse. we have a PR queued to add pooling but not in prod yet.
infra-raj: immediate plan: 1) throttle provisioner attach rate via rate-limiter at edge LB, 2) bump conntrack_max on controlplane hosts as temporary, 3) restart single controller-manager replica to unblock leader routines.
sre-maya: agreed, please run a canary restart first. oncall, please coordinate.
oncall-bot: @ops-lena executing canary restart on controller-manager-eu-0 now.
ops-lena: controller-manager-eu-0 restarted, leader switched to -eu-1, reconcilers resumed. queued reconciles dropped from 180 -> 40 in ~5m.
infra-raj: applied sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144 and reduced nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established to 120000. Monitoring memory.
platform-sam: applied temporary LB rate limit for provisioner egress: 120rps per instance. This reduced new connections by ~70%.
sre-maya: after mitigations 5xxs and accept-queue normalized. GPU attach backlog down to single digits.
infra-raj: follow-ups: add conntrack utilization alert, implement client-side connection pooling in provisioner (INF-4601), add apiserver accept-queue and syn-recv alerts, consider controlplane surge autoscale policy.
platform-sam: long term: connection pooling + exponential backoff will eliminate most churn. autoscaling controlplane for onboarding spikes is an option but costs more.
ops-lena: creating runbook snippet: ss -s, conntrack -L | wc -l, sysctl tweak, controller-manager restart steps, LB throttle instructions.
sre-maya: thanks everyone. please record timeline in postmortem and coordinate release window for pooling change.
platform-sam: I'll schedule a canary rollout this week with low-risk flags. :thumbsup:
